router_holds_balance.meaning: ERC20 token balance is already held on the router before injectAndCall is invoked

target_is_caller_chosen.meaning: the caller supplies an arbitrary (caller-chosen) target address for the forwarded tokens

caller_entitled_to_assets.meaning: the caller is the party entitled to the router-held ERC20 balances being forwarded

victim_tokens_forwarded_out.meaning: tokens stranded by victims are forwarded out of the router to the caller-chosen target

assumptions: injectAndCall is invoked by an unrelated caller (the attacker) rather than the party entitled to the router-held balances.
The forwarded amount is the router's self balance of the token; the report does not specify a subset.
The router-held balance belongs to victims whose tokens are stranded on the router.

unresolved.description: Report does not give an explicit access-control predicate or entitlement mapping; entitlement is represented as a grounded Boolean derived from the security intent rather than a concrete authorization check.
Whether the forwarded amount equals the full self balance or a subset is not specified beyond 'whatever ERC20 balance already sits'.

limitations: Entitlement and forwarding-outcome are qualitative Booleans; no numeric amount or concrete authorization check is bound.
Only the i_victim_tokens_forwarded impact is formalized; the separate pooled-drain impact is out of scope for this plan.
